role: No-fit comparison of observed and frozen-model high-pressure slope time courses
source: Waszkiewicz et al. (2025), Zenodo 18046315; authenticated 56-brew histories and frozen JOINT_CLOCK/D0 banks
rights: CC-BY-4.0 source data; original figure, no source artwork

encodings.panels: Stable-pressure time; observed-onset time (both signals aligned by observed onset)
encodings.x: Declared center of a fully supported 2-s native beverage-flow window (s)
encodings.y: Unweighted slope across nominal 9/11/13-bar condition means against their matched measured line pressures (g/s/bar)
encodings.color: A-J1 lambda=1; D0 diagnostic fresh-bed R0 beverage wrapper
encodings.solid_circles: LOCO, pooled different held-condition parameter/Mc sets
encodings.dashed_squares: DESCRIPTIVE_ALL, one common in-sample parameter/Mc set
encodings.shading: Pointwise observed 95% whole-brew bootstrap interval; prediction and paired intervals are in CSVs
encodings.lines: Connect declared time snapshots; not a fitted peak-time curve

ceiling: Conditional frozen-predictor behavior on this rig; pressure slopes do not replace underlying trajectories; no identified mechanism, physical validation or cross-corpus agreement
